units.source_text: 三年前的一个夏天，我和别人一样，背着行李，从上高地的温泉旅馆出发计划攀登穗高山。

en.t: One summer three years ago, like everyone else, I set out from a hot-spring inn in Kamikochi with my luggage on my back, planning to climb Mount Hotaka.

units.source_text: 众所周知，要登顶穗高山，只有沿着梓川逆流而上这一条路。

en.t: As everyone knows, the only way to reach the summit of Mount Hotaka is to follow the Azusa River upstream.

units.source_text: 我曾经还攀登过枪岳峰呢，穗高山更是易如反掌。

en.t: I had even climbed Mount Yarigatake before, so Mount Hotaka seemed easier still.

units.source_text: 因此，我没带什么向导，独自一人行攀爬在晓雾弥漫的梓川峡谷路上。

en.t: So I took no real guide with me and climbed alone along the Azusa River gorge path, wrapped in the mist of dawn.
